description: This file declares the class MigrationPreparerImplementation, which implements the IMigrationPreparer interface for managing JSON data store operations related to migration tasks, including reading/writing data, resetting, and component readiness handling.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing migration preparation functionalities, including data store management and component readiness status.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair into the data store JSON file.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the data store based on the key.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value from the data store given the key.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components marked as ready.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the data store or migration status.
